summary: Repair delivery audit of the whole Kiln Phase Model Tiers PRD at 1770639, after Phase 5. It re-read the 13 criteria whose code Phase 5 changed; the other 13 keep their earlier Implemented status. Three rounds ran. Phase 5's fixes are in, but four criteria are still built only in part: AC-PICK-06, AC-PICK-07, AC-AGENTS-03 and AC-FALLBACK-03. Some launch stops still don't name the choice's model, effort, source or where to change it, including Codex refusing the model. With Kiln not running, kiln handoff misses a Model defaults or tier change made after Kiln stopped. A split phase's detail loses its fallback facts. Claude Code's account isn't marked in use before Start. Phase 6 was added to build them. No criterion was amended and nothing was changed outside the requirements.
